t-7000.author: alice-pdx
t-7000.title: Solid oak dining table + 4 chairs - $220 (Alder District)
t-7000.body: Oak table 60x36, seats six with the leaf, four matching chairs. One chair has a wobble, easy fix. Pickup only, second floor walk-up, bring a friend. Cash. No holds.

replies.author: sellr_7731
replies.body: Still available? Can pick up Saturday.

replies.author: alice-pdx
replies.body: Yes, Saturday works. Reply with a time.

t-7003.author: bob_m
t-7003.title: Surly Cross-Check 56cm, steel, 1x10 - $650 (Hawthorne)
t-7003.body: Cross-Check frame, built up as a commuter: 1x10, 38mm tyres, fenders, rear rack. New chain and cassette this spring. Test ride with ID. Priced to sell, not to haggle.

replies.author: tuneup_tony
replies.body: Which crank? If it is the original I know someone looking.

replies.author: bob_m
replies.body: Original Surly crank, 40t ring. Send them over.

t-7007.author: alice-pdx
t-7007.title: ThinkPad T14 gen 3, 32GB, 1TB, Linux - $520 (Alder District)
t-7007.body: Ryzen 7, fresh install of whatever you want or blank. Battery at 88 percent health. Charger included. Local pickup, will demo.

replies.author: k_hiring
replies.body: Does the keyboard have the backlight?

replies.author: carol_nk
replies.body: Is there bike parking in the building?

replies.author: nw_landlord
replies.body: Covered rack in the back, locked gate.

t-7016.author: carol_nk
t-7016.title: Part-time bookkeeper for a small engineering shop, remote OK - $35/hr (Alder District)
t-7016.body: Ten hours a week, monthly close, payroll through a provider, one bank account. Must know accrual basis. Send a short note about what you have done, not a resume.

t-7023.author: alice-pdx
t-7023.title: Neighbourhood cleanup Saturday 9am, coffee provided (Alder District)
t-7023.body: Meet at the corner of Kearney and 11th. Bags and grabbers supplied, bring gloves. Two hours, then coffee at Northlight. Kids welcome.

replies.author: bob_m
replies.body: Booked him for two bikes last month. Showed up on time, both shift like new.

t-7026.author: carol_nk
t-7026.title: Math tutoring, algebra through calculus, in person or online - $45/hr (Belmont)
t-7026.body: Engineering degree, six years tutoring high school and first-year college students. First half hour free to see if we get along. Evenings and weekends.
